baseline: sequential climatology (running Laplace-smoothed base rate, per domain per seed); secondary constant 0.5.
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b (unmodified), affect=none, 10 episodes x 4 fresh seeds {73201,73202,73203,73204}, PredictionLog JSONL per seed, canonical derive_seed streams. 1560 ticks pooled per domain. Estimator: prototypes/architecture-b/competence_estimator.py feature_mode='A' (causal prequential replay).

config.estimator: competence_estimator.CompetenceEstimator variant A (online logistic + log-linear, climatology-anchored, normalized SGD eta_p=0.1/eta_e=0.05)

hypothesis: A causal online competence estimator (logistic recalibrator anchored on sequential climatology + error-history/surprise/churn features) predicts arch_b's own error magnitude: Brier beats sequential climatology on >=3/4 domains AND corr(predicted_uncertainty,|actual_error|)>=0.40 on >=3/4 domains.
interpretation: NEGATIVE (NULL-adjacent): neither win gate fires. Brier beats climatology on 2/4 domains only (D2 action_consequence 0.2488 vs 0.2504; D4 retrieval_usefulness 0.2460 vs 0.2471 -- both marginal; D1 0.2533 vs 0.2507 and D3 0.0780 vs 0.0771 LOSE). Coupling corr(uncertainty,|err|): 0.055/0.112/0.069/0.036 -- 0/4 reach 0.40. Mechanism (measured): changing_rule |err| is nearly temporally i.i.d. (lag-1 autocorr 0.13, ~0 by lag 5; episode means flat, no post-flip transient), so error-HISTORY features carry almost no signal; the 2 marginal beats come from the fast event-rate feature, not error-magnitude tracking. Kill arms: anchor-only reproduces Brier_climo to 1e-9 (PASS -- improvements are learned); error-permutation shows intact<permuted on D2/D4 (error features add small independent signal there). Unit tests 5/5 green, tripwire clean. Estimator remains PROTOTYPE (replay only, not wired into act()). Next: variant B (EXP-FP-0071) adds prediction-time novelty context (mean_similarity, n_nbrs, retrieval_used, e1_ema).
limitations: Single env (changing_rule), closed-loop; affect=none; prototype replay status; anchor means early ticks equal baseline by construction (pooled prequential Brier includes the transient honestly).
null_hypothesis: Brier_est >= Brier_climo on every domain AND/OR corr < 0.40 on every domain -- the estimator carries no competence information beyond the base rate (theater).
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_est vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace); corr(predicted_uncertainty,|actual_error|)>=0.40 gate; ECE/MCE reported. Preregistered: experiments/preregistration_EXP-FP-0070.json (sealed pre-run; two pre-run amendments documented therein, no battery data seen).
